summary: The merge queue builds five entries at once instead of three

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Repository settings only: max_entries_to_build in the main ruleset's merge_queue rule goes from 3 to 5. Merge method, HEADGREEN grouping, one to six entries per merge, the one-minute batch wait and the 120-minute check-response timeout are unchanged.

manual.detail: A repository administrator applies .github/repo-settings.json to ruleset 20563764 after this lands; CI never applies it. Check with gh-check-settings (docs/ci.md, Merge queue).

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes. Setting max_entries_to_build back to 3 restores the previous queue.
